description.value: The Steward Visitor Centre is a two-storey tourist information office in Stewart, BC, at the head of the Portland Canal near the Alaska border — a remote but iconic stop for cyclists riding the Cassiar Highway. Stewart sits at one of Canada's most northerly ice-free ports, surrounded by glaciers, fjords, and wildlife, and the visitor centre serves as the gateway orientation point for the area. Mobile reception is confirmed on site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM tags provide the primary evidence: toilets=yes confirms washrooms, mobile_reception=yes is noted, and check_date=2025-09-26 indicates the record was verified recently. The discovered website URL (stewart-hyder.com) resolves to a third-party travel blog ('Expert World Travel') covering the Stewart-Hyder region generally — it is not the visitor centre's own website and contains no amenity-specific details about this building. All amenity fields beyond washrooms must therefore remain null.
